channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Bahrain says it will not participate in Iran’s proposed Hormuz meeting
item.description: Iran tells Al Jazeera that Monday's meeting is a sign of 'good intentions' towards neighbouring countries.

item.title: Will Houthi advances in Yemen give Iran leverage in its war with the US?
item.description: The Iranian ally seizes Yemen's Red Sea coast, cementing their hold on the Bab al-Mandeb strait.

item.title: Iraq probes drone strikes on Saudi Arabia, shuts three crossings to Iran
item.description: PM Ali al-Zaidi dismisses commander, orders investigation into operations command in Maysan province, bordering Iran.

item.title: Iran, UAE hold first talks at BRICS summit since conflict began
item.description: Iran’s President has met Abu Dhabi’s Crown Prince at the BRICS summit for their highest-level talks since the war began.

item.title: Selling the war: Purges, polygraphs and propaganda
item.description: The Iran war has become ever more challenging for the Trump administration to sell.

item.title: Will the Houthi attacks activate the Mecca Pact?
item.description: If there is a Saudi request, Pakistan and Turkiye will intervene, but direct involvement in the Yemen war is unlikely.

item.title: At least seven killed in fire at prison in northern Syria
item.description: Inmates rioted following protests in the city of Kobane over the killing of former Kurdish fighter, state media reports.

item.title: Iranian official tells Al Jazeera IAEA ruling was imposed by US and Israel
item.description: Iranian official tells Al Jazeera an IAEA resolution on Tehran’s nuclear safeguards was ‘imposed’ by the US and Israel

item.title: Saudi Arabia shuts key oil pipeline after drone attack launched from Iraq
item.description: Iraq removes a military commander and opens investigations into the attack that came from an area bordering Iran.

item.title: Grammy-winning US rapper Lil Durk acquitted in murder-for-hire trial
item.description: The Chicago rapper was arrested in 2024 and accused of involvement in a shooting that killed the cousin of rival rapper Quando Rondo.
